# konnect_identity_vault_key (Resource)

IdentityVaultKey Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "konnect_identity_vault_key" "my_identityvaultkey" {
  directory_id = "3174b4e7-6a5d-4e3a-9ddb-9ee7251436da"
  name         = "...my_name..."
  public_key   = "-----BEGIN PUBLIC KEY-----\nMIIBIjANBgkqhkiG9w0BAQEFAAOCAQ8AMIIBCgKCAQEA...\n-----END PUBLIC KEY-----"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `directory_id` (String) ID of the directory
- `name` (String)
- `public_key` (String) PEM-encoded RSA or EC public key used to encrypt token vault data. Keys must be at least 2048 bits (RSA) or 256 bits (EC). Requires replacement if changed.

### Read-Only

- `algorithm` (String) The asymmetric algorithm of the vault key.
- `created_at` (String) An ISO-8601 timestamp representation of entity creation date.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `key_size` (Number) Size of the key in bits (for example 2048 for RSA, 256 for EC P-256).
- `kid` (String) RFC 7638 JWK thumbprint (base64url-encoded SHA-256 digest) of the public key.
- `updated_at` (String) An ISO-8601 timestamp representation of entity update date.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = konnect_identity_vault_key.my_konnect_identity_vault_key
  id = jsonencode({
    directory_id = "..."
    id           = "..."
  })
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import konnect_identity_vault_key.my_konnect_identity_vault_key '{"directory_id": "...", "id": "..."}'
```
